title: WOHD26: Together, let’s create a record-breaking chain of happy moments!
html:
As World Oral Health Day (WOHD) 2026 draws closer, the digital activation provides an easy way to get involved and help amplify the campaign message. By sharing happy moments online and using available resources, supporters can bring this year’s theme — “A Happy Mouth is… A Happy Life” — to life.

World Oral Health Day (WOHD) is just a few weeks away. To continue building momentum towards 20 March, we launched our digital activation on 13 February, bringing the campaign to life across digital platforms worldwide.

Under this year’s theme — “A Happy Mouth is… A Happy Life” — we are celebrating the importance of caring for our mouths at every age, because oral health is closely connected to overall health, well-being, and quality of life.

Be part of the “Happy Moments” Instagram activation

Toothie, our campaign star, is inviting supporters worldwide to help create a record-breaking chain of happy moments, powered by healthy smiles.

Getting involved is simple:

1.    Visit @toothiebeaver on Instagram
2.    Open the “Add Yours” story highlight
3.    Tap the “Add Yours” sticker
4.    Share your happy moment

Healthy smiles mean happy moments. By adding yours — whether it’s a simple shot of family life, a confident smile before a big moment, or a joyful celebration with your loved ones— you help us show the world how a happy mouth fuels a happy life at every stage.

Check out and share our digital activation factsheet

 

🎵 Bonus inspiration - Sing along!

Want to add even more joy? Stream “A Happy Mouth is a Happy Life” on your favourite music platform and help spread the message further. You can also add the song directly to your Instagram story when sharing your happy moment on Instagram.

Stream the song

Let’s make WOHD 2026 unforgettable.


 

We’re counting on you to help make WOHD 2026 a truly global movement

Don’t forget to share your WOHD plans on our map of activities.

No matter how you take part — whether through large initiatives or small local actions — your contribution matters.

Remember to register your activity, appear on the map, and share your outcomes. Exceptional initiatives will be celebrated through the World Oral Health Day Awards.

Collectively, we can promote a #HappyMouth for all.

 

Don’t miss Toothbrush talks - first two episodes out now

Follow Toothie’s friends at @toothiebeaver as they join “Toothbrush Talks”, sharing how a healthy smile helps you feel your best at every age.
